scripts.web:hosted: cd app && flutter build web --release --pwa-strategy=none --base-href=/ --dart-define=LOOP_HOSTED=true && cd .. && node -e "const f=require('fs');f.rmSync('hosted',{recursive:true,force:true});f.cpSync('app/build/web','hosted',{recursive:true});f.rmSync('hosted/canvaskit',{recursive:true,force:true})" && node scripts/check-web.js hosted
scripts.web: cd app && flutter build web --release --pwa-strategy=none && cd .. && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('src/web',{recursive:true,force:true});const f=require('fs');f.cpSync('app/build/web','src/web',{recursive:true});f.rmSync('src/web/canvaskit',{recursive:true,force:true})" && node scripts/check-web.js
